supplement.coverage_note: All 26 supplementary tables and both appendices were inventoried. Load-bearing evidence profiles used in SEA were reconciled against the supplement. Table-local citations were used as provenance and not duplicated into the main bibliography.

references.handling: The canonical main-guideline bibliography was extracted once. Supplementary table-local reference blocks were not duplicated as a second bibliography.

coverage_decisions: Every formal statement in the four-page summary of recommendations was atomized exactly once.
Underlying study effects summarized by KDIGO remain secondary evidence in the SEA and were not promoted to primary-study LiteratureAtoms.
The bibliography was extracted separately and not atomized.
The appendix and all supplementary evidence tables were inspected because they materially affect methods and evidence appraisal.

source_integrity_issues.location: Main Figure 1 S144 vs Supplementary Table S6
source_integrity_issues.issue: For sofosbuvir/velpatasvir in CKD G5D, Figure 1 reports High-quality evidence with total N=405, while Supplementary Table S6 reports 8 studies and N=629 for SVR12. Table S6 also prints 93.0% with a 95% CI of 93.0%-97.3%, an internally unusual interval whose lower bound equals the point estimate.
source_integrity_issues.handling: The discrepancy is preserved and flagged. No correction was inferred.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom pattern used in recent project guideline outputs has no dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind. Formal guidance is serialized as atom_kind="other" with descriptive tags.
Recommendation strength and GRADE certainty are preserved in tags rather than dedicated typed fields.
Trial results in this guideline are secondary reports. Primary-study atoms require separate extraction of the cited primary publications.
